name: Glowing Soul Gem
summary: In Ordil'Aran, the Glowing Soul Gem serves the Cult of the Dark Strand's work in northern Ashenvale. Shadow sorcery fills the stone, which holds the spirit of an unwitting victim.

sections.title: A Vessel of Dark Sorcery
sections.body: Northeast of Maestra's Post, the ruins of Ordil'Aran shelter members of the Cult of the Dark Strand and their shadowy masters. The cult's operatives carry Glowing Soul Gems, enchanted vessels that trap and torment the souls of the dead. These stones channel magical energy and bind spirits to the cult's ends.

sections.title: The Secrets of Ordil'Aran
sections.body: At Maestra's Post, Delgren the Purifier investigates the gems to weaken the Dark Strand's influence across northern Kalimdor. Deciphering a Glowing Soul Gem's enchantments reveals dark arcane formulas and an imprisoned soul crying out from within. The formulas expose experiments linking the cultists in Ashenvale to their kin at the Tower of Althalaxx.

faq.q: What is the Glowing Soul Gem?
faq.answer: The Cult of the Dark Strand uses the Glowing Soul Gem as an enchanted soulstone. Shadow magic traps spirits inside, so the cult can harness their essence for its sorcery.

faq.q: Where does this soul gem come from?
faq.answer: Members of the Cult of the Dark Strand carry the gem from the ruins of Ordil'Aran in northern Ashenvale. Its bearers include cultists, assassins, enforcers, and adepts.

faq.q: Who wants this soul gem and why?
faq.answer: Delgren the Purifier at Maestra's Post seeks the gem. He believes its enchantments will reveal the secret source of the cult's power and what they are plotting.

faq.q: What happens when the soul gem is deciphered?
faq.answer: Deciphering the gem's enchantments frees the ghost trapped within. The tormented soul is released, and the Dark Strand's practices are exposed.

angles.text: As a Warlock, you know the art of trapping spirits in soulstones. The Dark Strand's gem is a cruder, necromantic form of soul manipulation.
As a Priest, you can sense the agony of the spirit imprisoned in the gem. The artifact must be cleansed so the soul can find peace.
